mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals robust household demand for housing and associated consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals an active monetary tightening cycle that reduces market liquidity and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a synchronized labor-demand expansion that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS and RSAFS shows Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window or fails to predict positive returns in >55% of events.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust supply capacity utilization that boosts corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 210 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over a 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, sustained growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to the previous year drives corporate revenue expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when RSAFS is rising year-over-year.
